notes.h2: 2026-09-30 — ขน, ละ, เลี้ยง (25 filed, 8 false-split)
notes.h3: ละ — to let go, and "each"
notes.text:
**Unsure.** I left ละอาย (to feel ashamed) unfiled. None of ละ's senses reaches
shame. Its ละ- has the unstressed /la/ presyllable, not the verb /laʔ/. That
suggests it is not a compound at all, but nothing on disk says so, and so I did
not tag it. ละมุด stays `biological` for the same reason. ละอุ่น and ละงู are
toponyms and have no home.
